existing_docs: HR Policy: All PTO and vacation requests must be submitted at least two weeks in advance through the company Workday portal.
DB Connection: To connect to the staging database, use the hostname 'db.staging.internal' on port 5432. Credentials can be retrieved from AWS Secrets Manager under the key 'staging-db-readonly'.
